description: Model routing policy. Role defaults live in policies/agent-registry.json; this file defines how task complexity, risk and reasoning demand escalate or de-escalate that default. Model routing is intentionally separable from role definitions so it can evolve on its own release cadence.
principles: Role alone never determines the model. Role default + task risk + reasoning demand does.
Only model family aliases are used (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable, inherit). Dated model identifiers are never hard-coded, so the policy survives model releases.
Escalation is always allowed for correctness. De-escalation is allowed only for LOW-risk, well-specified, reversible work.
mandatory_escalation: Any security review of authentication, authorization, cryptography or secret handling runs on opus.
Any architecture decision recorded as an ADR runs on opus.
Any irreversible operation analysis (destructive migration, data deletion, production change) runs on opus.
Any evaluation that gates promotion of a HIGH or CRITICAL agent runs on opus.
de_escalation_allowed_for: Mechanical test scaffolding from an already-approved test design
Changelog and release-note assembly from an existing change list
operational_notes: Agent frontmatter carries the role default only. Per-invocation overrides are the escalation mechanism.
For agent-team teammates, the model is fixed at spawn time and cannot be changed afterwards, so the lead must apply this policy when it spawns, not later.
CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL overrides frontmatter for all subagents. Do not set it organization-wide: it defeats this policy.

fable is an accepted alias but the routing table never selects it. It exists so a project override can choose it for a role where speed matters more than depth, and resolve_model.py ranks it alongside sonnet so such an override neither escalates nor breaches a risk floor. A role at a HIGH or CRITICAL floor still cannot be overridden down to it.

Each routing rule's effort level is carried in the agent's own frontmatter. Claude Code validates `effort` on plugin agent files against low, medium, high, xhigh, max or an integer. It warns and ignores `permissionMode`, `hooks` and `mcpServers` on plugin agents, so those three are never set here; `skills`, `model`, `tools` and `effort` are all honoured.

overrides.description: Resolution order, highest priority first. Each layer may only be set by the authority named.

order.effect: A blocked value is substituted by Claude Code. A role that must run on opus in a restricted environment needs that verified, not assumed.

order.set_by: the delegating agent or the operator
order.effect: The escalation mechanism. Always permitted upward for correctness.
May raise a role above its default. May lower it only for roles the risk floor permits.

order.set_by: the workflow stage's risk and complexity
order.effect: Resolved through the routing table below.
The floor for the role when nothing else applies.

invariants: A project may never lower a role below the model floor for its risk class.
CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL overrides frontmatter for every subagent and must not be set organization-wide: it defeats this policy entirely.
A teammate's model is fixed at spawn. The lead resolves this policy when it spawns, because it cannot correct the choice afterwards.
